params.caption: Kechki choy bilan bitta kichkina masala. 2 ning x-darajasi 5 ga teng. Unda 4 ning (x+1)-darajasi nechchi bo'ladi? Birinchi o'yingiz x ni topish bo'lsa, shoshilmang: 4 ni boshqacha yozib ko'rsangiz, hammasi ikki qatorda yechiladi. Javobni so'rovnomada belgilang, yechimingizni izohlarda ko'rsating 😉 📌 https://registan.edutizim.uz/order/entry/?survey=s33 📞 +998935512700 📱 Follow us on social media: 📱Telegram 📱Instagram 📱Location

params.question: 2^x = 5 bo'lsa, 4^(x+1) nechaga teng?
params.explanation: 4^(x+1) = 4 · 4^x = 4 · (2^x)² = 4 · 5² = 4 · 25 = 100. x ni topish shart emas edi.
